evidence: Cic. Sen. 77: crēdō deōs immortālēs sparsisse animōs in corpora hūmāna (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Dī immortālēs, the immortal gods, is also an exclamation. Of fame, memory and thanks: everlasting (memoria et glōria, Cic. Balb. 40, Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: crēdō deōs immortālēs sparsisse animōs in corpora hūmāna
phrases.english: I believe the immortal gods have sown souls in human bodies
the year warns you not to hope for what is immortal
